title: Digi FX Control
author: Digital Alchemy DSP
description: The DIGI RING, DIGI FOLD and DIGI TILT pages on the master page tree (FUNC+LFO), rotated with LEFT/RIGHT or the on-screen < > arrows. The stock top status bar is kept. RING: on/off (A), depth (E), frequency (F). FOLD: on/off (A), fold type CLEAN/MUD/DIST/TRSH (D), amount (E/F/G/H all edit it), with the spiral, the big mode title, the amount slider and the level meter. TILT: on/off (A), low shelf (E), high shelf (H). Stock one-step-per-detent rate with acceleration (OS-style accumulation). Settings are stored per pattern inside the saved pattern data (they follow pattern switch / reload and a project save, like stock parameters). It drives digieq / digiring / digifold / digimeter (all required).
